definitions: To endure or tolerate something difficult or unpleasant.
To understand or interpret something in a particular way.
To accept a situation or fact.
To assume or believe something to be true.
To handle or deal with a situation or person.
examples: She can really take it when things get tough.
I take it you're not coming to the party.
You just have to take it as it comes.
I take it that's your final offer.
He knows how to take it when criticized.
